## Purpose
The account cards shared by `/account` and `/admin/account`: profile, password and active sessions.

## Responsibilities
- `Card` is the frame.
- `ProfileCard`: name, toast "Name updated".
- `PasswordCard`: "Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out."
- `SessionsCard`: device icon and user-agent description (`deviceIcon`, `describeAgent`); revoke gives "Session signed out".

## Key elements
`ProfileCard`, `PasswordCard`, `SessionsCard`, `Card`.

React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.
